title: Nudge the Judge: Uncovering Program Decision Hijacking in Real-World Jev Applications
abstract: arXiv:2610.18612v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: System One models such as Jev change how software makes decisions by mapping open-ended semantic contexts into structured judgments that directly drive program execution. However, this paradigm introduces a new security risk, which we term Jev Program Decision Hijacking (JPDH): attacker-controlled contexts can redirect program decisions through schema-valid Jev judgments. Existing evaluations focus primarily on model-level attacks or predefined injection channels, leaving attack reachability and downstream security consequences in real-world Jev applications underexplored.   In this paper, we present JevProbe, the first automated framework to evaluate JPDH by tracing adversarial influence from reachable context surfaces through program-consumed decisions to downstream security consequences in real-world Jev applications. translated_title: 轻推裁判：揭示真实世界Jev应用中的程序决策劫持
translated_abstract: 诸如Jev之类的系统一模型通过将开放式语义上下文映射为直接驱动程序执行的结构化判断，改变了软件做出决策的方式。然而，这一范式引入了一种新的安全风险，我们将其称为Jev程序决策劫持：攻击者控制的上下文可以通过符合模式的有效Jev判断来重定向程序决策。现有评估主要关注模型级攻击或预定义的注入渠道，而对真实世界Jev应用中的攻击可达性及下游安全后果的探索仍然不足。在本文中，我们提出了JevProbe，这是首个用于评估JPDH的自动化框架，它通过追踪对抗性影响——从可达的上下文表面，经过程序所消费的决策，直到真实世界Jev应用中的下游安全后果。我们的关键洞察是，应用逻辑将多样化的Jev判断映射为可观察的决策，从而实现系统性的……
tldr: 提出首个自动化评估框架JevProbe，通过追踪从可达上下文表面到程序决策再到下游安全后果的对抗性影响，系统揭示了真实世界Jev应用中程序决策劫持（JPDH）这一新型安全风险。
en_tdlr: JevProbe, the first automated framework for evaluating Jev Program Decision Hijacking (JPDH), traces adversarial influence from reachable context surfaces through program-consumed decisions to downstream security consequences in real-world Jev applications.
